name: Agent Info
description: Inspect swarm agents — tools, skills, shared KB, and curated memory.

function.name: agent_info
function.description: Cross-agent discovery. action=list → swarm roster (id, role, workplaces). action=get → one agent's enabled tools, linked/shared skills, shared knowledge-base sample, curated USER.md/MEMORY.md + agent_state. Use before delegate when you need to know who has bash/portal/web or which skills/KB exist. Knowledge base and skill catalog are swarm-wide; tool allowlists and MEMORY.md are per agent.

action.description: list = roster; get = detail for one agent (default get if agent set, else list)

agent.description: Agent id or name for get (defaults to current agent).
